name: excel
description: Read and analyse Excel workbooks. Read-only; parses .xlsx directly so Excel is not required.

docs_dir.title: Workbook folder
docs_dir.description: Folder of .xlsx/.xlsm workbooks the server may read. REQUIRED - the server refuses to start without it. Only the TOP LEVEL is listed, so keep workbooks directly in the folder rather than in sub-folders.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Absolute path to the python.exe that has this server's pip dependencies installed (e.g. C:\Python311\python.exe). Use plain 'python' only if the right interpreter is first on PATH - a mismatch here is the most common cause of 'dependency missing' errors.
